what: Several photos scattered around the section sit hidden and transparent at half size, pushed to different sides (±30~100% of their own size). When the section’s top edge touches the top of the screen, they all gather at once to full size and place and switch on with .5s ease — only once

options.at: Gathers when the section’s top edge is a few px below the top of the screen, default 0 (when touching)
options.ease: Curve — CSS name or bezier values, default ease
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photos to gather (children, several) — the parent sets positions with absolute
options.--fx-x · --fx-y: Offset direction per photo (via style, % of its own size) — brand 100%·50% / 100%·-100% / -100%·100% / -100%·-30% / -100%·-100%

from.where: index.html .bs-enjoy five photos around it (original .t-enjoy__img:nth-child(n) scale(.5) translate · transition all .5s · common_top.js enjoy — scrollTop ≥ section top edge)
